Your School ClockedIn

Welcome!

This app sends your work-based learning hours to your WBL supervisor at school.

To get started, scan the QR code your supervisor gave you with your phone's camera. It will open this app and set it up for you.

Have an enrollment code instead?

Your information stays on this phone until you choose to send it.

Send to your supervisor

Send to

1. Copy your supervisor's email address.

2. Tap Send and pick your email app. Paste the address in To and send.

Sending isn't working?

Option A: download the file and attach it to an email yourself.

Option B: send it as plain email text. This sends your numbers but not the photo.
